title: Hexwoven
description: A Hex Casting server using the modpack by the same name
body:
A server using the [modpack focusing on Hex Casting and Hex Casting addons of the same name](https://modrinth.com/modpack/hexwoven).

**Features**
- Use steampunk technology to automate farms
- Use magic to change how you play the game
- Play music on instruments
- Learn to be a hexcaster.
- Hang out with other people interested in the same things

**Server Address**
hex.tw25.net
